scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:web: set "NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://192.168.2.34:8002"&& set "NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=%LOCALAPPDATA%\mkcert\rootCA.pem"&& set "NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca"&& npm --prefix apps/web run dev -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3002 --experimental-https --experimental-https-key ..\..\192.168.2.34-key.pem --experimental-https-cert ..\..\192.168.2.34.pem
scripts.dev:api: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8002 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Error 'Port 8002 in use'; exit 1 }; & .\.venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn apps.api.main:app --reload --access-log --log-level debug --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8002 --ssl-keyfile 192.168.2.34-key.pem --ssl-certfile 192.168.2.34.pem"
